Assemble shuttle and secure with two M1.2 Torx T4 screws on back
Functional test for 4 mm travel without rattle

insight.meaning: A linear minimal pendant that translates core Bauhaus ideas into jewelry using honest industrial materials titanium and matte stainless steel with visible logic of construction and no superfluous ornament. It targets smart casual outfits and sits at an accessible retail band near €150 in Europe. ([moma.org](https://www.moma.org/calendar/galleries/5388?utm_source=openai))
insight.cultural: Europe associates Bauhaus with functional clarity social progress and the unity of art craft and industry that still shapes everyday objects and visual culture. The movement was born in Germany in 1919 and spread across Europe through designers and museums then re-entered policy discourse via the New European Bauhaus which links design to sustainability and inclusion. For European consumers a Bauhaus inflected pendant signals rational taste quiet modernity and cross border design heritage rather than regional ornament. ([metmuseum.org](https://www.metmuseum.org/de/essays/the-bauhaus-1919-1933?utm_source=openai))
insight.background: Bauhaus education combined formal studies of space color and composition with applied workshops in metalwork cabinetmaking weaving and typography under figures such as Walter Gropius László Moholy Nagy Paul Klee and Wassily Kandinsky. The metal workshop in Weimar and Dessau produced prototypes for modern living and influenced jewelry scale metalwork including work by Naum Slutzky often characterized by geometric reduction and function driven construction. ([moma.org](https://www.moma.org/calendar/galleries/5388?utm_source=openai))
symbols: Positive functional clarity form follows function social good via good design. ([sothebys.com](https://www.sothebys.com/en/art-movements/bauhaus?utm_source=openai))
Positive democratization of culture and everyday impact. ([oeil.europarl.europa.eu](https://oeil.europarl.europa.eu/oeil/en/procedure-file/pdf?reference=2021%2F2255%28INI%29&utm_source=openai))
Positive honesty of materials and industrial craft lineage. ([metmuseum.org](https://www.metmuseum.org/de/essays/the-bauhaus-1919-1933?utm_source=openai))
Negative can feel austere or impersonal if abstract geometry is used without functional rationale. ([goethe.de](https://www.goethe.de/ins/mm/en/kul/mag/21412385.html?utm_source=openai))
colors: Core neutrals titanium grey steel grey graphite black to emphasize structure and surface

Optional micro accents in primary colors red yellow blue derived from Bauhaus color form studies used sparingly along edges screws or cord terminations. ([bauhaus.de](https://www.bauhaus.de/en/sammlung/highlights/204_unterricht/444?utm_source=openai))
materials: Titanium for low weight corrosion resistance and high biocompatibility generally hypoallergenic. ([bluenile.com](https://www.bluenile.com/education/metal/titanium?utm_source=openai))

316L stainless steel for durable matte structures low nickel release when correctly specified and finished. ([bssa.org.uk](https://bssa.org.uk/bssa_articles/selection-and-use-of-stainless-steels-for-skin-contact-and-body-piercing-jewellery-applications/?utm_source=openai))

Surface treatments brushed satin or bead blasted to lower reflectivity and reveal linear grain or soft non directional texture. ([worldstainless.org](https://worldstainless.org/about-stainless/process-and-production/surface-treatment/?utm_source=openai))

Optional anodized titanium accents that create stable interference colors without dyes when used on small planes or fasteners. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anodizing?utm_source=openai))
forms: Rectilinear bars plates channels or slim extrusions with clear edge breaks and radii sized for comfort
Geometric primitives circle square triangle referenced only when they support structure or clasp geometry
Proportional modules that read as grid units for example equal bar segments or stepped volumes echoing workshop prototypes

Joints designed as honest details tiny screws tubes or rivets visible and aligned with the form axis rather than hidden decoration. ([metmuseum.org](https://www.metmuseum.org/de/essays/the-bauhaus-1919-1933?utm_source=openai))
motion: Rhythm by repetition of equal or alternating linear units building quiet pulse along the pendant axis following Klee’s basic rhythm studies

Balanced tensions between vertical and horizontal reads using spacing rather than curvature to create visual movement. ([openendedgroup.com](https://openendedgroup.com/field2/assets/Klee_Paul_Pedagogical_Sketchbook_1960.pdf?utm_source=openai))
cliches: Triad of red yellow blue slapped on generic shapes without functional reason avoid it or it reads as superficial Bauhaus cosplay. ([velvetmatter.art](https://velvetmatter.art/journal/bauhaus-in-jewellery-and-object-design-a-visual-guide/?utm_source=openai))
Random triangles circles squares with no connection to clasp mechanics or wearability

Over polishing that contradicts utilitarian intent when the design concept calls for matte functional surfaces. ([worldstainless.org](https://worldstainless.org/about-stainless/process-and-production/surface-treatment/?utm_source=openai))
cautions: EU nickel release law applies to jewelry in prolonged skin contact so components must meet EN 1811 migration limits 0.5 microgram per square centimeter per week for most items and 0.2 for posts. Market claims like nickel free are insufficient without release testing. ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?qid=1724082961094&uri=CELEX%3A02006R1907-20240606&utm_source=openai))

Use grade appropriate stainless non free machining sulfur rich grades can exceed nickel release thresholds. ([outokumpu.com](https://www.outokumpu.com/en/sustainability/-/media/files/sustainability/outokumpu-eu-safety-information-sheet-stainless-steel-2023.pdf?modified=20230705085841&revision=466ad64b-bfe7-4302-b6d2-383ba574fde7&utm_source=openai))

Price positioning around €150 should be justified through material choice and finishing quality comparable EU retail shows titanium or stainless pendants in roughly €110 to €190 which supports a €150 target. ([schmuckwerk-shop.com](https://www.schmuckwerk-shop.com/pendants/pendants-stainless-steel-titanium.html?utm_source=openai))

Respect the term Bauhaus. Use inspired by rather than implying institutional endorsement and anchor any visual references in functional choices drawn from workshop practice. ([metmuseum.org](https://www.metmuseum.org/de/essays/the-bauhaus-1919-1933?utm_source=openai))

sets.name: Planar Grid
sets.concept: A strict right angle bar language in titanium and matte steel delivers a calm Bauhaus statement for smart casual days.
sets.story: This set distills Bauhaus utility into two intersecting bars and a measured offset. Plain titanium meets matte steel to create tonal contrast without gloss. Tiny primary color squares act as wayfinding notes rather than decoration. The build is robust and serviceable to keep pricing clear and the pendant near 150 euro.
sets.metal: Grade 2 titanium in neutral gray and 316L stainless steel in matte silver with an optional black DLC steel variant for a deeper tone.
sets.surface: Titanium bead blasted matte near 800 grit and steel linear brushed near 400 grit with a soft micro chamfer around 0.3 mm and a clear anti fingerprint coating.
sets.stones: No gemstone. Optional 1.5 mm square glass enamel insert in red or blue or yellow set flush at one end of the bar.
sets.silhouette: An elongated rectangle in a one to two point five proportion with a short cross bar placed at one third.
sets.motif: A right angle intersection of two flat bars.
sets.rhythm: One long bar with a shorter cross bar repeats at regular intervals of two units then one unit across the bracelet. The ring keeps bilateral symmetry with a single offset cross bar on the top. The pendant presents a single intersection that reads clearly from a distance.
sets.structure: A steel core bar slides inside a titanium sleeve and locks with two flush micro screws on the back to allow maintenance. The pendant uses a hidden slot bail inside the junction so a chain stays invisible from the front. The ring uses a comfort steel inner band with titanium outer rails pinned by two small screws. The bracelet uses short H links that alternate long and short bars for easy articulation. Adhesives are limited to the enamel insert.
design_dna: Always compose from straight bars with right angles or parallel lines.
Keep all surfaces matte and free of mirror polish.
Maintain small edge chamfers around 0.3 mm for comfort.
Accent color appears as a small square or short line and covers less than ten percent of visible area.
Hidden bails and closures keep hardware invisible on the front.
Thickness targets between 2 mm and 3.2 mm to stay light and durable.
Use titanium for elements that touch skin and steel for structural spans.
Target retail for the pendant near 150 euro in Europe with rings and bracelets scaled in the same value logic.
Proportions favor a one to two point five rectangle and a one third offset.

concept_art.form: Abstract composition of orthogonal bars on a neutral field, rectangles of varied length aligned to a grid, strong right angles, generous negative space
concept_art.motion: Slow sliding alignment of linear elements that approach then pause then continue, a calm cadence
concept_art.material: Matte titanium texture and bead blasted steel grain with diffuse light and soft shadows, no gloss
concept_art.atmosphere: Quiet studio mood with rational clarity and small Bauhaus primary color squares placed with precision

sets.name: Module Fold
sets.concept: Friendly chamfered modules in titanium and matte steel build a versatile unisex line with clear primary accents.
sets.story: This set optimizes parts count and finishing for consistent pricing and volume production. A folded steel shell carries a titanium face plate so weight stays low and feel stays solid. Ceramic pigment infill in primary colors brings the Bauhaus note without fragile gems. Every clasp and bail is tool free and easy so people can wear it daily with smart casual outfits.
sets.metal: 316L stainless steel folded shell in matte silver and grade 2 titanium face plate in neutral gray with optional black PVD steel spacers for contrast.
sets.surface: Cross brushed faces and micro bead blasted sides with a soft corner radius near 1 mm and a durable anti scratch top coat.
sets.stones: None. Primary accents are fired ceramic pigment infill in shallow channels that sit fully flush.
sets.silhouette: A rounded rectangle module with a centered longitudinal channel and a constant thickness near 2.4 mm.
sets.motif: A stacked module unit defined by a clean central groove.
sets.rhythm: The bracelet repeats five identical modules separated by thin steel spacers with equal gaps. The ring is a continuous band with a single centered groove. The pendant is a vertical module hung through a hidden rear slot so the front channel reads as unbroken.
sets.structure: A one piece folded steel shell wraps a titanium face and locks by hidden tabs so a jeweler can open it for service. The bracelet uses a flat box clasp integrated as a sixth module. The ring adds an inner spring shim to allow micro sizing from EU size 52 to 62. The pendant bail is a rear keyhole that slides over a cable or flat chain and stays unseen from the front.
design_dna: Use a rounded rectangle with a clear central channel as the anchor geometry.
Keep surfaces low gloss and consistent in grain between parts.
Let color live only in small infill zones and never on more than fifteen percent of the visible area.
All closures and joints must be tool free for the user and serviceable by a jeweler.
Edges are softened with a small radius for comfort over long wear.
Manufacture with a minimal parts count and repeatable finishes to protect price targets around 150 euro for the pendant.
All items must read unisex in proportion and avoid tapered or dainty cues.
When engraved marks are needed place them on the back and keep them under one millimeter in height.
Maintain compatibility with standard European chains and bracelets through simple slot bails and box clasps.

concept_art.form: Soft cornered rectangles arranged in a tidy stack, a shallow central groove running through each tile, clean modular grid
concept_art.motion: Subtle click like progression as modules align and space repeats, a friendly step by step rhythm
concept_art.material: Matte steel silver and gray titanium with fine linear brushing, tiny pools of saturated primary color ceramic infill
concept_art.atmosphere: Approachable industrial calm with product like clarity, lit as a storefront display without glare

sets.name: Axis Drift
sets.concept: Kinetic rails in titanium and matte steel allow a silent slide and pivot that turns Bauhaus lines into restrained motion.
sets.story: This set explores how minimal geometry can move without noise or fuss. Each piece holds a floating shuttle that slides a few millimeters inside parallel rails. A single dark or white insert anchors the eye and keeps the color language disciplined. The motion feels calming in the hand and reads smart and technical on the body.
sets.metal: Grade 2 titanium rails for skin contact and 316L stainless steel bases for stiffness with optional black DLC coated steel shuttles for a deep monochrome variant.
sets.surface: Micro peened matte on titanium and satin brushed steel on flats with an edge radius around 0.2 to 0.4 mm and a dry lubricant wax in channels.
sets.stones: Optional zirconia ceramic rod in matte black or white about 2 mm by 8 mm set as a floating pin inside the shuttle.
sets.silhouette: Two parallel rails separated by a precise negative space with a short central shuttle that reads as a compact bar.
sets.motif: An axis track with a movable bar captured inside.
sets.rhythm: The bracelet alternates fixed rail modules and short gaps in a pattern of two then one then two. The ring places the shuttle at the top and limits travel to a short arc. The pendant hangs vertically so the shuttle rests at the lower stop and climbs a little with the wearer movement.
sets.structure: Titanium U channels screw to a steel base from the rear and hide all fasteners. The shuttle glides on a concealed PTFE liner and is retained by invisible end stops. The ring uses a tiny pivot pin that allows a short travel arc. The bracelet clasp hides under a rail module and locks with a low profile tongue for a seamless front.
design_dna: Express motion through straight guides and short linear travel only.
Keep the moving piece silent and free of rattle by using liners or dry film.
Surfaces are fully matte to highlight form not shine.
Color is limited to a single dark or white insert or a small blue line.
All fasteners are hidden on the back and use standard tools for service.
Edges stay crisp yet safe with a tiny radius.
The pendant must read as a clean line when the shuttle is at rest and must fit a smart casual outfit.
Design for production with affordable parts so the pendant can sit near 150 euro in retail.
Maintain unisex proportions and avoid dramatic size jumps across sizes.

concept_art.form: Parallel rails with a small bar that slides within, large negative space and strict right angles in an abstract field
concept_art.motion: Gentle glide along an axis with a soft stop, repeat and pause, a meditative mechanical gesture
concept_art.material: Matte titanium and satin steel surfaces with faint wear on contact points, dark insert in ceramic or DLC
concept_art.atmosphere: Quiet kinetic study with cool studio light and a slightly technical mood
